channel.title: Title22 Blog
channel.description: Plain-language guides for California care homes and families: CDSS Community Care Licensing, Title 22, RCFEs, ARFs, administrator certification, inspections and the people who help.

item.title: What Is CDSS Community Care Licensing? A Plain Guide for California Care Homes
item.description: Who CDSS and its Community Care Licensing Division are, what they license, how inspections and complaints work, and the official pages to bookmark.

item.title: What Is Title 22? How California's Care-Home Rules Are Organized
item.description: Title 22 explained in plain words: Division 6, the RCFE and ARF chapters, how it fits with the Health and Safety Code, and where to read it free.

item.title: RCFE vs ARF in California: What's the Difference?
item.description: Who each home serves, which Title 22 chapter applies, and how administrator training, the exam and renewal differ, side by side.

item.title: How to Check a California Care Home Before You Choose
item.description: For families: look up the license, read inspection and complaint reports, ask the right questions, and know who to call for help.

item.title: Who's Who in California's Care-Home Community
item.description: A map of the agencies and groups around California RCFEs and ARFs: Licensing, the Ombudsman, APS, regional centers, trainers, associations and advocates.

item.title: DSS Is at Your Door: What Analysts Check First in an RCFE Visit
item.description: Medication records, staff files, resident charts, postings, and incident follow-through: the five things a licensing analyst goes to first, and how to be visit-ready every day.

item.title: RCFE Admission Paperwork: Every LIC Form You Need, Explained
item.description: LIC 601, 602A, 603, 625, and the rest of the complete resident file: what each form does, who signs it, and which ones must be updated after admission.

item.title: ICTP Requirements for New RCFE Administrators in California
item.description: The 80-hour training program, the 60-day exam window and three-attempt rule, the LIC 9214 application, and the timeline from enrolled to certified.

item.title: RCFE Administrator Recertification: The 40-Hour CE Checklist
item.description: The 40 hours and how they must split, live vs self-paced, dementia and law/regulation minimums, plus what a lapsed certificate actually costs you.

item.title: How to Choose a DSS-Approved RCFE CE Course (Without Wasting Hours)
item.description: Vendor approval numbers, the live/self-paced split, required topics, and the questions to ask any CE vendor before you pay.

item.title: Title 22 Medication Documentation Requirements for RCFEs: The Complete Checklist
item.description: Every record your facility needs to keep for medications: centrally stored med logs, MAR entries, PRN documentation, and destruction records, and what a DSS analyst checks first.
